patch_description: Split hub entanglement into per-edge parameters to increase expressivity. Previously, center-to-edge CRX/CRY gates used shared parameters across opposite edges (edges 1 with 5, edges 3 with 7). This change assigns separate parameters hub_crx_1, hub_crx_5, hub_cry_3, hub_cry_7 for the four center-edge gates, enabling more flexible entangling patterns while still respecting adjacency constraints. This increases per-block parameter count slightly but can improve fits and generalization by providing more nuanced hub coupling patterns.
